title: Add TUI-ready boot marker and initramfs manifest fields
purpose: Make image and initramfs artifacts prove that the packaged system includes a TUI-ready operator console.
scope: Add TUI-ready marker to initramfs or boot handoff evidence.
Add TUI config hash and operator command registry hash to image manifest.
Expose marker through boot smoke output.
Keep AGENTD_HANDOFF_OK and runtime manifest markers intact.
Fail build when TUI defaults are missing or invalid.
acceptance_criteria: Initramfs or image manifest contains TUI-ready console evidence.
Manifest records hashes for TUI config and operator command registry.
Boot marker is observable without interactive terminal control.
Existing runtime-aware boot markers remain present.
failure_modes: TUI-ready claim exists only in documentation.
Boot smoke cannot observe the TUI marker.
New marker breaks existing handoff or runtime manifest checks.
